text.hi: किसी की बात आगे बताते समय: I → she, today → that day, this → that, और समय पीछे: is → was, has bought → had bought, would like → would like।
text.hinglish: Kisi ki baat aage bataate samay: I → she, today → that day, this → that, aur samay peechhe: is → was, has bought → had bought, would like → would like.
text.en: When reporting: I → she, today → that day, this → that, and the tense moves back: is → was, has bought → had bought.

steps.question: Asha: "I don't want to play today."
options: She said that she didn't want to play that day.
She said that I don't want to play today.
She said that she doesn't want to play today.
steps.answer: She said that she didn't want to play that day.

steps.question: Asha: "I am buying this pair of jeans."
options: She said that she was buying that pair of jeans.
She said that I am buying this pair of jeans.
She said that she is buying this pair of jeans.
steps.answer: She said that she was buying that pair of jeans.

text.hi: मनुजा ने अपनी दादी के बारे में बताया। अनिल को बताओ। उदाहरण: She told that her grandmother was widely travelled.
text.hinglish: Manuja ne apni daadi ke baare mein bataaya. Anil ko batao. Udaaharan: She told that her grandmother was widely travelled.
text.en: Manuja told you about her grandmother. Tell Anil. Example: She told that her grandmother was widely travelled.

steps.question: Manuja: "She's recently bought a new dress."
options: She told that her grandmother had recently bought a new dress.
She told that my grandmother has recently bought a new dress.
She told that her grandmother buys a new dress.
steps.answer: She told that her grandmother had recently bought a new dress.

steps.question: Manuja: "She's written a number of books."
options: She told that her grandmother had written a number of books.
She told that her grandmother has wrote a number of books.
She told that my grandmother had written a number of books.
steps.answer: She told that her grandmother had written a number of books.

steps.question: Manuja: "She's very interesting company."
options: She told that her grandmother was very interesting company.
She told that her grandmother is very interesting company.
She told that my grandmother was very interesting company.
steps.answer: She told that her grandmother was very interesting company.

steps.question: Manuja: "She's recently broken her left foot."
options: She told that her grandmother had recently broken her left foot.
She told that her grandmother has recently broke her left foot.
She told that my grandmother had broken my left foot.
steps.answer: She told that her grandmother had recently broken her left foot.
